visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a tall plastic cup containing a layered, frothy tea drink with a blue hash-symbol logo on the front. The background is a clean, minimalist storefront with the words 'TEA PROJECT' visible above the door. (2) Deep amber tea is poured over large, clear ice cubes inside a transparent blender pitcher. (3) A lid is placed on the blender, and the tea and ice are processed into a frothy mixture. (4) The frothed tea is poured into a plastic cup, creating a thick layer of bubbles on top. (5) A metal slotted spoon scoops translucent, jelly-like rectangular toppings into a cup filled with ice. (6) Several shots follow showing different variations of the tea, including a reddish fruit-infused version and a layered version where white milk is poured into dark oolong tea. (7) The camera shows a clean, grey-walled interior of a shop with a large blue logo on the wall and two staff members in black uniforms and masks working at the counter. (8) The exterior of the shop features a large white banner with black and gold text advertising 'BAI HAO OOLONG' and 'OOLONG TEA PROJECT'. (9) The video concludes with two hands holding up different tea drinks, clinking them together in front of a blue background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice begins narrating, set against a bright, upbeat electronic pop background track with a prominent four-on-the-floor kick drum pattern. (2) A clear, splashy sound of liquid being poured is layered over the music as the voice describes the new tea products. (3) The rhythmic drone of a blender whirring is heard briefly, punctuating the narration. (4) The narrator's speech rate increases slightly while detailing specific ingredients, accompanied by the muffled metallic clink of a scoop and the wet texture of jelly toppings. (5) A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs between scene segments. (6) The vocal tone remains consistently joyful and persuasive, with music continuing at a steady tempo without interruption until the final greeting and sign-off.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and promote the new 'Bai Hao Oolong' series of tea drinks at 'De Jeng Oolong Tea Project' by highlighting their unique ingredients and flavors to attract local customers.
